avis.titre: Warning: Can cause bad breakouts—test cautiously first
avis.texte: I normally do not write reviews but wanted to caution people with this one. Obviously everyone's skin is different, but I usually do not breakout from things and I had one of the worst breakouts I've ever had from specifically this azelaic acid. I have used The Ordinary's azelaic acid for years with decent results and thought I would try this product to see if I liked the formulation better but that was a big mistake! My skin erupted in multiple stubborn pimples a few days into using this. This product may be fine for some people but it seems like there are others that have written reviews about badly breaking out so if you are going to try this go VERY slow to make sure it's not a problem for you. Learn from my mistake and don't assume that because you tolerate one formulation of azelaic acid that it will be the same for this one.
